rule_citation: policy_checker 'pre_existing_damage': narrative explicitly mentions prior unrepaired damage to the same area
narrative: The front passenger corner of my car has had a cracked bumper cover and a dented fender since I scraped a concrete post last winter, and I never got it repaired. This month a driver ran the stop sign on {location} and clipped that same corner. The shop is quoting the bumper cover and fender as one job.
